entries.subject: Cassini ISS archive and PDS shape release
entries.finding: The [Cassini ISS calibrated archive](https://pds-rings.seti.org/cassini/iss/) supplies the observation lens and the [PDS shape release](https://sbn.psi.edu/pds/resource/saturnsatshapes.html) supplies geometry and radial-height visualization.

entries.subject: Cassini frame N1828136577_1
entries.finding: `N1828136577_1` has a PDS table center sample of 790.20, inconsistent with the body in the image near sample 490. The earlier `N1828134597_1` covers this region at finer resolution; no camera-center correction is invented.
entries.revisitWhen: A corrected camera centre for this frame is published.

entries.subject: Voyager-era Stooke and Celestia maps
entries.finding: The Voyager-era Stooke shaded-relief and Celestia maps represent a different, older cartographic interpretation and cannot be described as Cassini observed pixels; the original Western University distribution URL currently returns 404. They add no qualified improvement over the chosen Cassini frames.
entries.revisitWhen: A registered observational map improves on the Cassini frames.

entries.subject: SBIB Cassini catalog as a download path
entries.finding: [SBIB’s Cassini catalog](https://sbn.psi.edu/pds/sbib/saturn.html) currently omits Prometheus from its listed targets. This is a limitation of that catalog, not a claim that other Prometheus datasets do not exist.

entries.subject: A second IR3/GRN/UV3 sequence
entries.finding: N1643263159_1, N1643263046_1 and N1643263237_1 expand sampled False color physical-area coverage from 30.3% to 38.1%. The new filters pass independent feature checks against green. The two encounters have no accepted overlap, so their relative brightness is left unmatched. Current-main browser qualification remains pending.
